gotchas: The /cart/<variantId>:1 permalink 302s straight into /checkouts/cn/<token> with skip_shop_pay=true — there is no cart page hop and no Shop Pay diversion; guest card checkout is the default.

Checkout renders a duplicate hidden autofill form whose inputs carry the same name attributes (autofill_firstName, autofill_city, ...). Plain input[name=firstName] matches two elements; scope every contact/billing selector with :not([id^=autofill]).
Visible billing field ids are randomised per render (TextFieldP0-734 etc.) except #billing-address1 and #email — select by name, not id.
The CVV iframe is named card-fields-verification_value-<rand>, not card-fields-verification-<rand>.
Digital products (e.g. the $1 ringtone) skip the shipping step entirely, so checkout is a single page: contact, billing, card.
Custom domain store: detection must key on cdn.shopify.com script/link references and meta[name=shopify-checkout-api-token], not on a *.myshopify.com host.
